description: The tray popover's own capability set. It is not on the `default` capability because it needs three permissions and none of the rest: granting a window autostart, updater and process:restart it never calls is a wider surface than the popover has any use for. Kept narrow deliberately, and the three are exactly what the popover's code calls: `listen` for the live security-event feed (AG-578) and the proxy-state event, its cleanup `unlisten`, and `hide` for dismissing itself. A window absent from every capability can still invoke application commands, so the popover rendered data and looked healthy while every push it subscribed to was refused: the feed's events never arrived and dismissal silently failed.
